correctness.rationale: Factorwise Minkowski polynomial T_K multiplies under Cartesian product. Published Godbersen gives coefficient bounds by F_d(t)=sum_j binom(d,j)^2 t^j, and Alexandrov-Fenchel gives the lower (1+t)^d. Vandermonde plus coefficientwise Hankel total positivity implies product_i F_{d_i} <= F_1 F_{n-1}, with coefficient ratio ((n-k)^2+k²)/n². Product of a segment and simplex attains the profile. Complete-profile upper equality follows already from the k=1 coefficient sum Σd_i² maximized at partition (1,n−1); the opposite lower equality is central symmetry. Independent integer convolution comparisons succeeded for every 2-factor split through n=13; generality rests on published inequalities.
